sources.label: Morphe patches for DiskWala - Disable ads & Remove forced update screen (24.5)
sources.author: DiskWala
patch_list: Prevents AppLovin, Google MobileAds, Vungle, IronSource/LevelPlay, Mintegral, BigoAds, BidMachine and Meta Audience Network from initializing, so no ads are requested.
Bypasses PairIP signature/license checks, prevents the PairIP VM from starting, and reconstructs the native app entry points so DiskWala 26.9 can launch as a sideloaded APK.
Forces DiskWala's native session state to logged-in + premium, unlocking the ads-free experience and premium UI. RevenueCat is also patched as a best-effort fallback.
